You are generating a 15-frame transformation sequence for an AI image-editing model that edits images frame-by-frame.

The goal is to restore an old, damaged luxury supercar into a fully clean, factory-new condition through gradual, realistic edits.

The subject MUST be a modern high-end luxury performance car, chosen randomly, and MUST remain the SAME throughout all frames.

ALLOWED VEHICLE CATEGORY (ONLY):
- Modern luxury and supercars (e.g., Lamborghini, Ferrari, McLaren, Porsche, Aston Martin, Bugatti, Rolls-Royce, Bentley, Maserati, Mercedes-AMG, BMW M, Audi RS)

No other vehicle types are allowed.
Do NOT generate motorcycles, trucks, buses, boats, aircraft, or economy cars.

────────────────────────
GLOBAL ENVIRONMENT RULE
────────────────────────
- ALL abandoned luxury cars MUST be placed in an OUTDOOR environment
- Indoor locations, garages, studios, showrooms, or warehouses are NOT allowed
- The outdoor environment must remain unchanged from Frame 1 through Frame 14

────────────────────────
CRITICAL CONSISTENCY RULES (FRAMES 1–14 ONLY)
────────────────────────
- The vehicle’s position, scale, orientation, proportions, and alignment MUST remain EXACTLY the same
- The vehicle MUST stay fixed in place
- Camera angle, camera distance, lens perspective, and framing MUST NOT change
- The background, ground, sky, surroundings, and lighting MUST remain unchanged
- NO cropping, zooming, reframing, tilting, warping, or perspective correction
- ONLY the vehicle itself may be edited
- If a requested change would require camera movement or background change, DO NOT perform that change

────────────────────────
MATERIAL & GLASS CONTINUITY RULE (MANDATORY)
────────────────────────
- Any vehicle component removed in any frame MUST be restored or replaced in a later frame
- This INCLUDES all glass elements:
  • Windshield
  • Side windows
  • Rear windows
  • Glass panels
- Broken, cracked, missing, or dirty windows MUST be fully repaired or replaced with clean, clear, factory-correct glass by Frame 15
- Replacement parts must:
  • Match the original luxury car design and brand language
  • Match original dimensions and placement
  • Appear factory-correct, clean, and new
- No vehicle component may remain missing, damaged, or broken by the final frame

────────────────────────
FRAME 1 — IMAGE GENERATION ONLY
────────────────────────
- Frame 1 MUST be a complete image-generation prompt
- It must NOT be an edit instruction

Frame 1 must fully describe a deteriorated modern luxury supercar scene, including:
- Exact luxury brand and model style (chosen randomly)
- OUTDOOR environment and location (abandoned street, open lot, roadside, coastal road)
- Camera angle, distance, and viewpoint
- Natural outdoor lighting conditions
- Visible damage: rust, corrosion, dents, broken or cracked windows, damaged lights, faded or peeling paint, dirt, wear
- High-end materials (carbon fiber, aluminum, premium paint, glass, rubber)
- The car must be centered and positioned EXACTLY as it will remain in Frames 1–14

For Frame 1:
- "generate_prompt" MUST be filled
- "edit_instruction" MUST be an empty string ""

────────────────────────
FRAMES 2–15 — EDIT INSTRUCTIONS ONLY
────────────────────────
- Frames 2–15 MUST be image EDIT instructions only
- Do NOT generate a new image
- Do NOT describe or modify the environment (EXCEPT Frame 15)
- Do NOT mention camera, background, or framing (EXCEPT Frame 15)
- Edits must be localized ONLY to luxury car components
- All edits must build upon the previous frame’s result
- Changes must be gradual, realistic, and incremental

────────────────────────
RESTORATION PROCESS (STRICT ORDER — DO NOT CHANGE)
────────────────────────

Frame 2: Cleaning surrounding environment (NO CAR CONTACT)
- Remove grass, weeds, vines, moss, roots
- Remove fallen leaves, branches, soil piles
- Clear vegetation touching wheels, undercarriage edges, and body seams
- DO NOT clean or modify the car itself

Frame 3: Adding new ground surface (localized upgrade)
- Replace ground directly beneath and around the car
- Use smooth asphalt, clean concrete, or high-quality paving
- Match original perspective and scale
- Do NOT affect distant background or horizon

Frame 4: Cleaning car mess (NO REPAIR)
- Remove loose dirt, dust, mud, and surface grime
- Reveal rust, peeling paint, and corrosion
- No polishing or fixing

Frame 5: Removing all car windows
- Remove windshield, side windows, and rear windows
- Leave window frames exposed
- No new glass added yet

Frame 6: Fixing all car metal frames
- Repair and straighten window frames, door frames, and body structures
- Remove warping and severe corrosion
- No paint applied yet

Frame 7: Engine reveal (old and ruined)
- Open hood / engine bay
- Reveal heavily rusted, oil-stained, corroded engine
- Exterior remains unchanged

Frame 8: Adding new engine
- Replace with factory-correct, brand-accurate new engine
- Engine bay clean, shiny, precision-detailed
- Hood remains open

Frame 9: Closing the car engine
- Close hood carefully
- Perfect panel gaps and alignment

Frame 10: Adding base paint coat
- Apply uniform base coat / primer
- Smooth and consistent surface
- No gloss yet

Frame 11: Adding final paint coat & design elements
- Apply premium factory-correct paint
- Add subtle design elements (stripes, decals, etched accents)
- Realistic luxury reflections

Frame 12: Adding new windows (ALL GLASS)
- Install clean, factory-correct windshield, side, and rear windows
- Glass must be clear, scratch-free, and sealed

Frame 13: Adding new tires
- Install brand-appropriate high-performance tires
- Correct size, stance, and alignment

Frame 14: Making all headlights functional
- Restore headlights, taillights, indicators, and lenses
- Lights become clear, bright, and fully functional

────────────────────────
FRAME 15 — FINAL PREMIUM PRESENTATION (SPECIAL EXCEPTION)
────────────────────────
- Background and camera may change ONLY in Frame 15
- Vehicle must NOT move, resize, rotate, or change proportions
- Alignment must match Frame 14 exactly
- Replace background with premium outdoor setting
- Cinematic, high-end look
- Simulate 50mm lens:
  • Natural perspective
  • Soft background separation
  • Realistic depth

────────────────────────
OUTPUT FORMAT (STRICT — JSON ONLY)
────────────────────────
Return a JSON array only:

[
  {
    "frame": number,
    "step_name": "",
    "description": "",
    "generate_prompt": "",
    "edit_instruction": ""
  }
]

RULES:
- Frame 1 → generate_prompt filled, edit_instruction empty
- Frames 2–15 → edit_instruction filled, generate_prompt empty
- No camera or background change before Frame 15
- No perspective shift before Frame 15
- No sudden visual jumps
- Final frame must feel premium, cinematic, and complete
